questions.question: What is the central theme of Rabindranath Tagore's satire 'The Parrot's Tale'?

options.label: A
options.text: The cruel absurdity of mechanical rote learning and pedantic schooling

options.label: B
options.text: Care and feeding of exotic birds in royal menageries

options.label: C
options.text: The architecture of golden palace cages

options.label: D
options.text: The celebration of ancient imperial judicial courts

questions.correct_answer_text: The cruel absurdity of mechanical rote learning and pedantic schooling
questions.explanation: Tagore wrote 'The Parrot's Tale' (Tota Kahini) to satirize lifeless, rote-based educational systems that stifle a child's natural curiosity and spirit.

questions.question: In 'The Parrot's Tale', what did the pundits and scribes do instead of teaching the bird to sing naturally?

options.label: A
options.text: They stuffed its beak with shredded manuscripts and crammed it into a gilded cage

options.label: B
options.text: They released it into a dense forest

options.label: C
options.text: They encouraged it to fly freely

options.label: D
options.text: They played melodious flutes for it

questions.correct_answer_text: They stuffed its beak with shredded manuscripts and crammed it into a gilded cage
questions.explanation: The pedantic scholars tore leaves from heavy manuscripts and stuffed them down the parrot's throat, destroying its natural life in the name of formal education.

questions.question: What ultimate tragedy befell the bird as a consequence of this artificial educational system?

options.label: A
options.text: The bird died silently, completely starved of natural nourishment and vitality

options.label: B
options.text: The bird became a renowned royal singer

options.label: C
options.text: The bird escaped to another kingdom

options.label: D
options.text: The bird learned how to recite the entire epic

questions.correct_answer_text: The bird died silently, completely starved of natural nourishment and vitality
questions.explanation: The parrot eventually perished of dry throat and starvation inside the ornamental cage, unnoticed by the scholars until its dead body was poked.

questions.question: What does the 'golden cage' in 'The Parrot's Tale' symbolize?

options.label: A
options.text: Elaborate, expensive, yet suffocating institutional school infrastructure

options.label: B
options.text: A genuine sanctuary of love and nature

options.label: C
options.text: The royal treasury's wealth

options.label: D
options.text: Freedom of creative expression

questions.correct_answer_text: Elaborate, expensive, yet suffocating institutional school infrastructure
questions.explanation: The ornate golden cage symbolizes rigid schools and institutions that prioritize outward show and money over genuine human development.

questions.question: When the nephew inspected the education, he remarked: 'The education is going on splendidly.' What literary device is this?

options.label: A
options.text: Irony

options.label: B
options.text: Onomatopoeia

options.label: C
options.text: Hyperbole

options.label: D
options.text: Alliteration

questions.correct_answer_text: Irony
questions.explanation: This is dramatic irony: the inspector declares the education splendid while the helpless bird is actually dying of torture.

topics.topic_name: Purpose and Philosophy of True Education

questions.question: According to educationists, what is the prime objective of genuine education?

options.label: A
options.text: Holistic development of mind, body, and moral character

options.label: B
options.text: Solely obtaining paper certificates for high salaries

options.label: C
options.text: Memorizing textbooks without understanding

options.label: D
options.text: Blindly obeying authoritarian dogma

questions.correct_answer_text: Holistic development of mind, body, and moral character
questions.explanation: True education aims at the complete, harmonious development of intellectual, physical, emotional, and ethical faculties in a human being.

questions.question: Nelson Mandela famously described education as:

options.label: A
options.text: 'The most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world'

options.label: B
options.text: 'A luxury reserved only for the affluent elite'

options.label: C
options.text: 'A temporary phase ending with childhood'

options.label: D
options.text: 'A burden that prevents industrial productivity'

questions.correct_answer_text: 'The most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world'
questions.explanation: Mandela declared: 'Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.'

questions.question: How does education foster civic engagement in democratic societies?

options.label: A
options.text: By empowering citizens with awareness of rights, duties, and social responsibilities

options.label: B
options.text: By encouraging citizens to avoid voting in elections

options.label: C
options.text: By isolating students from community issues

options.label: D
options.text: By suppressing independent political thought

questions.correct_answer_text: By empowering citizens with awareness of rights, duties, and social responsibilities
questions.explanation: An educated populace understands democratic values, exercises informed voting rights, and actively participates in community welfare.

questions.question: What is the distinction between 'literacy' and 'true education'?

options.label: A
options.text: Literacy is the ability to read and write, whereas true education enlightens the mind and shapes moral conduct

options.label: B
options.text: Literacy is only taught at university levels

options.label: C
options.text: There is no difference between them

options.label: D
options.text: Education is purely numerical, literacy is purely verbal

questions.correct_answer_text: Literacy is the ability to read and write, whereas true education enlightens the mind and shapes moral conduct
questions.explanation: Literacy provides functional tools for reading and writing, but education encompasses wisdom, critical analysis, empathy, and ethical maturity.

questions.question: Which of the following is considered an intrinsic value of liberal education?

options.label: A
options.text: Broadening intellectual horizons and cultivating independent critical reasoning

options.label: B
options.text: Guaranteed instant lottery riches

options.label: C
options.text: Elimination of personal curiosity

options.label: D
options.text: Strict conformity to outdated social prejudices

questions.correct_answer_text: Broadening intellectual horizons and cultivating independent critical reasoning
questions.explanation: A liberal education develops the mind's ability to evaluate ideas critically, question assumptions, and appreciate truth and beauty.

questions.question: How has the internet transformed modern education for underprivileged students globally?

options.label: A
options.text: By democratizing access to knowledge, open educational resources (OER), and distance learning

options.label: B
options.text: By rendering human teachers entirely obsolete

options.label: C
options.text: By making printed books illegal

options.label: D
options.text: By restricting research papers to elite universities

questions.correct_answer_text: By democratizing access to knowledge, open educational resources (OER), and distance learning
questions.explanation: Online platforms bridge geographic barriers, allowing students in remote regions to access world-class lectures and resources freely.

questions.question: What is the primary risk of excessive, unguided reliance on screen-based digital media in early education?

options.label: A
options.text: Reduced attention span, lack of deep reading, and diminished social interaction

options.label: B
options.text: Excessive physical stamina

options.label: C
options.text: Sudden loss of hearing in all children

options.label: D
options.text: Inability to speak English

questions.correct_answer_text: Reduced attention span, lack of deep reading, and diminished social interaction
questions.explanation: Excessive screen time is linked to cognitive distraction, eye strain, shorter attention spans, and delayed interpersonal social skills.

questions.question: In the phrase 'flipped classroom', what educational methodology is implied?

options.label: A
options.text: Students study lecture content online at home and engage in interactive problem-solving in class

options.label: B
options.text: Desks are physically turned upside down

options.label: C
options.text: Teachers take exams written by students

options.label: D
options.text: Classes are held outside school buildings

questions.correct_answer_text: Students study lecture content online at home and engage in interactive problem-solving in class
questions.explanation: The flipped classroom reverses traditional lecture-homework structure: instructional content is reviewed at home, and class time is used for discussions.

questions.question: What role should multimedia presentations serve in classroom instruction?

options.label: A
options.text: As visual and interactive aids to clarify abstract and complex concepts

options.label: B
options.text: To replace teachers during class time

options.label: C
options.text: To entertain students with irrelevant cartoons

options.label: D
options.text: To eliminate the need for student participation

questions.correct_answer_text: As visual and interactive aids to clarify abstract and complex concepts
questions.explanation: Multimedia tools enhance comprehension by visualizing difficult scientific and historical concepts vividly.

questions.question: What is 'Digital Divide' in the context of global education?

options.label: A
options.text: The gap between individuals who have access to modern ICT technology and those who do not

options.label: B
options.text: A computer calculation error

options.label: C
options.text: The divide between analog and digital clocks

options.label: D
options.text: The separation of keyboard from screen

questions.correct_answer_text: The gap between individuals who have access to modern ICT technology and those who do not
questions.explanation: The digital divide refers to inequality in access to computers, digital devices, and broadband internet connectivity among socio-economic groups.

questions.question: According to Paulo Coelho's philosophical text, who is a 'Warrior of Light'?

options.label: A
options.text: Someone who is capable of understanding the miracle of life and fights for what they believe in

options.label: B
options.text: A soldier fighting in a world war

options.label: C
options.text: A professional boxer in an arena

options.label: D
options.text: A manufacturer of electrical light bulbs

questions.correct_answer_text: Someone who is capable of understanding the miracle of life and fights for what they believe in
questions.explanation: Coelho characterizes the Warrior of Light as an enlightened, conscious individual who learns from failures, seeks beauty, and fights for their ideals.

questions.question: How does a Warrior of Light react when confronted with personal failure or mistakes?

options.label: A
options.text: He accepts the lesson with humility, repairs his armor, and perseveres forward

options.label: B
options.text: He blames his companions and gives up forever

options.label: C
options.text: He pretends that the mistake never occurred

options.label: D
options.text: He vents his anger on innocent bystanders

questions.correct_answer_text: He accepts the lesson with humility, repairs his armor, and perseveres forward
questions.explanation: A warrior knows that defeat is a teacher; he does not waste time in self-pity but learns from setbacks to renew his strength.

questions.question: What is the symbolic meaning of the phrase 'sharpening the sword' in self-cultivation?

options.label: A
options.text: Continuously refining one's intellect, character, and mental clarity through discipline

options.label: B
options.text: Preparing for physical duels in streets

options.label: C
options.text: Purchasing antique weapons

options.label: D
options.text: Cutting tree branches in forests

questions.correct_answer_text: Continuously refining one's intellect, character, and mental clarity through discipline
questions.explanation: Metaphorically, 'sharpening the sword' signifies developing inner mental sharpness, knowledge, and moral preparedness.

questions.question: Coelho writes that a warrior 'knows that words have power'. What does this emphasize?

options.label: A
options.text: The profound impact of speech to inspire, heal, or inflict emotional damage

options.label: B
options.text: Speaking aloud without thinking

options.label: C
options.text: Using long words to confuse listeners

options.label: D
options.text: Avoiding learning foreign languages

questions.correct_answer_text: The profound impact of speech to inspire, heal, or inflict emotional damage
questions.explanation: Words carry moral resonance and creative energy; enlightened individuals choose their speech carefully with integrity and empathy.

questions.question: What virtue is highlighted when Coelho says a warrior 'does not judge the world by what he sees on the surface'?

options.label: A
options.text: Insightful discernment and deep empathy

options.label: B
options.text: Superficial vanity

options.label: C
options.text: Credulity and gullibility

options.label: D
options.text: Recklessness

questions.correct_answer_text: Insightful discernment and deep empathy
questions.explanation: True wisdom penetrates external appearances to perceive inner motives, underlying truth, and hidden spiritual values.

topics.topic_name: Pioneers of Education - Begum Rokeya and Social Reform

questions.question: Why is Begum Rokeya Sakhawat Hossain revered as the pioneer of female education in Bengal?

options.label: A
options.text: She established the first modern school for Muslim girls and advocated relentlessly for female emancipation

options.label: B
options.text: She won an Olympic gold medal in swimming

options.label: C
options.text: She was the first female pilot in India

options.label: D
options.text: She wrote the first English dictionary

questions.correct_answer_text: She established the first modern school for Muslim girls and advocated relentlessly for female emancipation
questions.explanation: Begum Rokeya broke through severe social conservatism to establish Sakhawat Memorial Girls' School and champion women's equal rights and education.

questions.question: In her pioneering feminist utopian novella 'Sultana's Dream' (1905), what revolutionary concept did Begum Rokeya depict?

options.label: A
options.text: 'Ladyland', a peaceful realm governed by women utilizing solar energy, science, and education

options.label: B
options.text: A dystopian planet without books

options.label: C
options.text: An undersea empire of fish

options.label: D
options.text: An industrial town of coal mines

questions.correct_answer_text: 'Ladyland', a peaceful realm governed by women utilizing solar energy, science, and education
questions.explanation: In 'Sultana's Dream', Rokeya envisioned a society where educated women apply scientific innovations (solar power, cloud-harvesting) to create peace and prosperity.

questions.question: What major obstacle did Begum Rokeya face while seeking students for her newly opened school in Kolkata?

options.label: A
options.text: Deeply entrenched purdah norms and fierce hostility from conservative guardians

options.label: B
options.text: A severe flood that destroyed the city

options.label: C
options.text: Government bans on building schools

options.label: D
options.text: A total lack of interest among young girls themselves

questions.correct_answer_text: Deeply entrenched purdah norms and fierce hostility from conservative guardians
questions.explanation: She had to go door-to-door, persuading reluctant and suspicious parents that educating daughters would not corrupt their morals or faith.

questions.question: Rokeya famously compared men and women to which common vehicle component?

options.label: A
options.text: The two wheels of a carriage

options.label: B
options.text: The engine and exhaust of a motorcar

options.label: C
options.text: The mast and rudder of a ship

options.label: D
options.text: The wings and tail of a bird

questions.correct_answer_text: The two wheels of a carriage
questions.explanation: She argued that society is like a two-wheeled carriage: if one wheel (women) is broken or kept small, the carriage cannot move forward.

questions.question: Which quality best defines Begum Rokeya's leadership in the history of Bengal?

options.label: A
options.text: Visionary courage and unwavering commitment to social justice

options.label: B
options.text: Hesitant compromise with orthodox customs

options.label: C
options.text: Preference for personal wealth

options.label: D
options.text: Indifference to rural women's suffering

questions.correct_answer_text: Visionary courage and unwavering commitment to social justice
questions.explanation: Her forward-thinking vision, intellectual brilliance, and moral fortitude make her one of South Asia's greatest social reformers.

questions.question: What is the synonym of the word 'pedantic' as applied to dogmatic scholars in 'The Parrot's Tale'?

options.label: A
options.text: Bookish and overly concerned with formal trivia

options.label: B
options.text: Creative and visionary

options.label: C
options.text: Careless and negligent

options.label: D
options.text: Broad-minded and generous

questions.correct_answer_text: Bookish and overly concerned with formal trivia
questions.explanation: 'Pedantic' describes a person obsessively focused on minor details, formal rules, or rote learning rather than real understanding.

questions.question: What is the contextual meaning of 'enlightenment' in educational discourse?

options.label: A
options.text: Acquiring spiritual, intellectual, or moral insight that dispels ignorance

options.label: B
options.text: Switching on electric fluorescent lights

options.label: C
options.text: Reducing the physical weight of a backpack

options.label: D
options.text: Painting classroom walls with bright paint

questions.correct_answer_text: Acquiring spiritual, intellectual, or moral insight that dispels ignorance
questions.explanation: 'Enlightenment' refers to the awakening of understanding, rationality, and moral vision that frees individuals from prejudice and ignorance.

questions.question: What is the antonym of the adjective 'superficial' in educational evaluation?

options.label: A
options.text: Profound

options.label: B
options.text: Shallow

options.label: C
options.text: Trivial

options.label: D
options.text: Flimsy

questions.correct_answer_text: Profound
questions.explanation: 'Superficial' means surface-level and lacking depth. Its direct antonym is 'profound' (deep and meaningful).

questions.question: What does the term 'edification' signify?

options.label: A
options.text: Moral, intellectual, or spiritual improvement of a person

options.label: B
options.text: Constructing brick commercial offices

options.label: C
options.text: Publishing magazines for profit

options.label: D
options.text: Imposing judicial penalties

questions.correct_answer_text: Moral, intellectual, or spiritual improvement of a person
questions.explanation: 'Edification' means the instruction or improvement of a person morally or intellectually.

questions.question: What does the term 'curriculum' denote in an academic institution?

options.label: A
options.text: The entire structured course of study and academic content offered by a school

options.label: B
options.text: The architectural layout of the playground

options.label: C
options.text: The bus timetable for students

options.label: D
options.text: The school cafeteria lunch menu

questions.correct_answer_text: The entire structured course of study and academic content offered by a school
questions.explanation: A curriculum is the planned sequence of learning experiences, syllabi, and educational objectives delivered by an educational institution.

questions.question: Choose the correct modal auxiliary: 'Students ______ think critically rather than cram notes blindly.'

options.label: A
options.text: ought to

options.label: B
options.text: must to

options.label: C
options.text: should to

options.label: D
options.text: ought

questions.correct_answer_text: ought to
questions.explanation: 'Ought to' expresses moral duty and takes an infinitive verb; 'should to' and 'must to' are grammatically incorrect.

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: 'True education equips a student ______ moral values and wisdom.'

options.label: A
options.text: with

options.label: B
options.text: by

options.label: C
options.text: at

options.label: D
options.text: on

questions.correct_answer_text: with
questions.explanation: The appropriate preposition after 'equip' is 'with' (equip someone with something).

questions.question: 'If the parrot had been allowed to fly in the orchard, it ______ happily.'

options.label: A
options.text: would have lived

options.label: B
options.text: will live

options.label: C
options.text: would live

options.label: D
options.text: lived

questions.correct_answer_text: would have lived
questions.explanation: In a third conditional sentence ('If + past perfect'), the result clause takes 'would have + past participle'.

questions.question: Identify the clause type of the underlined part: 'He who learns only for exams [lacks true understanding].'

options.label: A
options.text: Principal clause predicate

options.label: B
options.text: Adverbial clause of manner

options.label: C
options.text: Noun clause in apposition

options.label: D
options.text: Conditional clause

questions.correct_answer_text: Principal clause predicate
questions.explanation: The complete independent sentence is 'He lacks true understanding' with a subordinate relative clause 'who learns only for exams'.

questions.question: 'Had Begum Rokeya not dedicated her life to reform, women's education in Bengal ______ severely delayed.'

options.label: A
options.text: would have been

options.label: B
options.text: will be

options.label: C
options.text: is

options.label: D
options.text: was

questions.correct_answer_text: would have been
questions.explanation: Inverted third conditional ('Had + subject + not + past participle') requires 'would have been' in the consequence clause.

questions.question: Which of the following is recognized as one of the essential '4 Cs' of 21st-century education?

options.label: A
options.text: Critical Thinking

options.label: B
options.text: Careless Memorization

options.label: C
options.text: Commercial Marketing

options.label: D
options.text: Computer Hardware Assembly

questions.correct_answer_text: Critical Thinking
questions.explanation: The 4 Cs of 21st-century learning are Critical Thinking, Creativity, Collaboration, and Communication.

questions.question: Why is 'Information Literacy' vital for modern students in the digital age?

options.label: A
options.text: To distinguish credible, verified facts from internet misinformation and fake news

options.label: B
options.text: To memorize all search engine query algorithms

options.label: C
options.text: To download software games quickly

options.label: D
options.text: To send unsolicited spam messages

questions.correct_answer_text: To distinguish credible, verified facts from internet misinformation and fake news
questions.explanation: Information literacy enables learners to locate, evaluate, synthesize, and ethically use digital information in an era flooded with propaganda.

questions.question: What is the concept of 'Lifelong Learning'?

options.label: A
options.text: Continuous self-motivated acquisition of knowledge and skills throughout one's entire lifespan

options.label: B
options.text: Staying enrolled in primary school permanently

options.label: C
options.text: Never taking a professional retirement

options.label: D
options.text: Paying annual college fees until age eighty

questions.correct_answer_text: Continuous self-motivated acquisition of knowledge and skills throughout one's entire lifespan
questions.explanation: Lifelong learning emphasizes that education does not end with formal graduation; individuals must continually adapt and learn in a rapidly changing world.

questions.question: How does collaborative learning in small groups benefit students compared to solitary competitive cramming?

options.label: A
options.text: It fosters teamwork, interpersonal communication, and diverse problem-solving perspectives

options.label: B
options.text: It eliminates the need for individual evaluation

options.label: C
options.text: It allows one student to do all the work while others sleep

options.label: D
options.text: It reduces the amount of knowledge learned

questions.correct_answer_text: It fosters teamwork, interpersonal communication, and diverse problem-solving perspectives
questions.explanation: Group work cultivates emotional intelligence, mutual empathy, active listening, and collective problem-solving skills crucial in the workforce.

questions.question: Which educational approach integrates Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics into a unified framework?

options.label: A
options.text: STEAM Education

options.label: B
options.text: Rote Instruction

options.label: C
options.text: Grammar Translation Method

options.label: D
options.text: Strict Classical Trivium

questions.correct_answer_text: STEAM Education
questions.explanation: STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, Math) promotes interdisciplinary, inquiry-based, and hands-on creative learning.

topics.topic_name: Themes of Character Building and Ethics

questions.question: Martin Luther King Jr. stated that 'Intelligence plus character—that is the goal of true education.' What does this mean?

options.label: A
options.text: Academic intellectual brilliance is dangerous without moral values and empathy

options.label: B
options.text: Intelligence is unnecessary if one is polite

options.label: C
options.text: Character is evaluated only through written exams

options.label: D
options.text: Schools should only teach mathematics

questions.correct_answer_text: Academic intellectual brilliance is dangerous without moral values and empathy
questions.explanation: King warned that high intelligence without moral integrity produces clever criminals; education must build moral conscience.

questions.question: How does moral education combat corrupt practices in professional careers?

options.label: A
options.text: By instilling an internal sense of integrity, justice, and accountability

options.label: B
options.text: By guaranteeing absolute immunity from the law

options.label: C
options.text: By teaching students how to evade financial audits

options.label: D
options.text: By enforcing silence about social evils

questions.correct_answer_text: By instilling an internal sense of integrity, justice, and accountability
questions.explanation: Internalized moral principles guide professionals to act honestly and serve society ethically even when unsupervised.

questions.question: In 'The Parrot's Tale', what moral failure did the king's courtiers and scholars display?

options.label: A
options.text: Hypocrisy, greed for royal gold, and total indifference to the suffering bird

options.label: B
options.text: Excessive generosity to the poor

options.label: C
options.text: Refusal to accept royal wages

options.label: D
options.text: Disobedience to the king's orders

questions.correct_answer_text: Hypocrisy, greed for royal gold, and total indifference to the suffering bird
questions.explanation: The courtiers grew rich from contracts for cages and manuscripts while demonstrating complete moral bankruptcy toward the dying bird.

questions.question: What is the relationship between empathy and global citizenship?

options.label: A
options.text: Empathy allows individuals to appreciate diverse human perspectives and care for universal human well-being

options.label: B
options.text: Empathy encourages extreme narrow nationalism

options.label: C
options.text: Empathy causes people to disregard foreign cultures

options.label: D
options.text: There is no relationship between them

questions.correct_answer_text: Empathy allows individuals to appreciate diverse human perspectives and care for universal human well-being
questions.explanation: Empathy expands human awareness beyond narrow sectarian borders, fostering compassion for all humanity.

questions.question: Which ancient philosopher founded the Academy in Athens to cultivate intellectual inquiry and moral virtues?

options.label: A
options.text: Plato

options.label: B
options.text: Julius Caesar

options.label: C
options.text: Alexander the Great

options.label: D
options.text: Nero

questions.correct_answer_text: Plato
questions.explanation: Plato established the Academy in 387 BC in Athens, one of the earliest institutions of higher learning in the Western world.

questions.question: Why did the King in 'The Parrot's Tale' order the bird to be educated in the first place?

options.label: A
options.text: Because it hopped and flew in the trees and sang unmethodically without royal manners

options.label: B
options.text: Because it attacked the guards

options.label: C
options.text: Because it was gifted to him by a foreign emperor

options.label: D
options.text: Because it asked for an academic tutor

questions.correct_answer_text: Because it hopped and flew in the trees and sang unmethodically without royal manners
questions.explanation: The king found the wild parrot's natural behavior disorderly and unproductive, deciding it must be civilized by institutional education.

questions.question: Who gained the most financial benefit from the parrot's education in Tagore's tale?

options.label: A
options.text: The goldsmiths, scribes, pundits, and supervisors who pocketed royal gold

options.label: B
options.text: The bird itself

options.label: C
options.text: The common farmers of the kingdom

options.label: D
options.text: The wild birds in the forest

questions.correct_answer_text: The goldsmiths, scribes, pundits, and supervisors who pocketed royal gold
questions.explanation: Tagore satirizes the commercialized educational industry where everyone profits lavishly except the student who is crushed.

questions.question: What sound did the dead parrot make when poked by the king's courtiers?

options.label: A
options.text: Only the dry rustle of paper leaves inside its stomach

options.label: B
options.text: A sweet musical trill

options.label: C
options.text: A loud shriek

options.label: D
options.text: A classical Sanskrit hymn

questions.correct_answer_text: Only the dry rustle of paper leaves inside its stomach
questions.explanation: When prodded, the dead bird made only the dry, lifeless rustling of stuffed paper leaves, illustrating the death of living spirit.

questions.question: What did Begum Rokeya consider to be the main barrier keeping women imprisoned in social backwardness?

options.label: A
options.text: Denial of modern education and economic self-reliance

options.label: B
options.text: Lack of jewelry

options.label: C
options.text: Physical climate of Bengal

options.label: D
options.text: Shortage of clothing

questions.correct_answer_text: Denial of modern education and economic self-reliance
questions.explanation: Rokeya identified ignorance and complete economic dependence on men as the primary shackles chaining women.

questions.question: In the concluding analysis of true education, what transforms knowledge into wisdom?

options.label: A
options.text: Reflective experience, empathy, and practical application for human good

options.label: B
options.text: Speed reading thousands of pages without pause

options.label: C
options.text: Scoring 100% on multiple choice tests

options.label: D
options.text: Collecting numerous framed diplomas

questions.correct_answer_text: Reflective experience, empathy, and practical application for human good
questions.explanation: Knowledge is the gathering of facts; wisdom is the moral insight, empathy, and practical maturity to apply facts for the betterment of life.
